metadata.title: कुकी को हथियार और फंड कौन देता है? | Who is giving fund and gun to Kuki people?
metadata.description:
In the interview with Ms. L Grace Haokip, she was asked about the allegations regarding Kuki terrorists providing guns and funds to Kukis to fight the Meitei community in Manipur, as well as the serious allegations of Kukis being involved in poppy cultivation and using the money to unleash violence in the state.
Ms. Haokip vehemently denied these charges during the interview. She stated that these allegations were baseless and lacked any truth. Furthermore, Ms. Haokip refuted the accusations related to poppy cultivation. She clarified that the Kuki community is no more cultivating poppy after 2021.

#manipur
